note: Source identity registry used by schema/semantic_validate.py in generated mode. Only the brand itself, its domains, generic store/rating patterns and live endpoints are kept as plain patterns; real people, organisations, customer domains, CTA labels and copy are stored as hashes in schema/source-identity-hashes.json so this repo never transcribes them. DERIVED BY extraction/build_source_brand.py; no human has reviewed the set.
normalization: Before matching, every string is NFKC-normalised, zero-width characters (U+200B-200F, U+2060, U+FEFF) are removed, curly quotes become straight quotes and runs of whitespace collapse to one space. Patterns are matched case-insensitively with re.search.
reviewStatus: UNREVIEWED. Detection is string-based: a paraphrase, a translation, a homoglyph that survives NFKC, text inside an image, or a first-name-only reference passes.

sourceBrand.note: The ordinary Greek-mythology name Cadmus is blocked on purpose: it is the source brand. 'Lovework' is the studio credited in the footer; 'Learning Assurance Analytics' and 'Uplifting Assessment' are the source's product name and tagline.

storeAndMarketplace.note: The clone renders no app-store mark or link; these generic patterns are precautionary (evidence row only shows the source's domain).

rating.note: The source renders no review site rating; its nearest claim is the 'rated excellent by students' highlight on case studies, blocked together with generic score phrasings.

liveEndpoints.note: The webinar registration button and the job cards link to live third-party form / application endpoints. Forbidden in every mode; reference examples replace them with '#'.

cta.rule: a generated action label is rejected when it starts with one of these verbs and names the source brand/product, or when it equals a source CTA label of 3+ words (hashed) that is not one of the generic labels.
